	end

-- Maximum stack size per slot
local MAX_STACK = 99
-- Number of slots in the inventory
local SLOT_COUNT = 20

--- Creates a new InventoryService instance for a player.
-- @param player: The Player instance.
-- @return InventoryService
function InventoryService.new(player: Player): InventoryService
	local self = setmetatable({}, InventoryService)
	self.player = player
	-- Initialize inventory with 20 nil slots
	self.inventory = table.create(SLOT_COUNT)
	for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
		self.inventory[i] = nil
	end
	return self
end

--- Moves an item from one slot to another.
-- @param fromSlot: The source slot number (1-20).
-- @param toSlot: The destination slot number (1-20).
-- @return boolean: True if successful, false otherwise.
-- @return string?: Error message if failed.
function InventoryService:MoveItem(fromSlot: any, toSlot: any): (boolean, string?)
	-- Validate that both slots are integers
	if type(fromSlot) ~= "number" or type(toSlot) ~= "number" then
		return false, "Both slots must be numbers"
	end
	
	if not math.isfinite(fromSlot) or not math.isfinite(toSlot) then
		return false, "Both slots must be finite numbers"
	end
	
	-- Check if they are integers
	if fromSlot ~= math.floor(fromSlot) or toSlot ~= math.floor(toSlot) then
		return false, "Both slots must be integers"
	end
	
	-- Validate slot range
	if fromSlot < 1 or fromSlot > SLOT_COUNT or toSlot < 1 or toSlot > SLOT_COUNT then
		return false, "Slots must be between 1 and 20"
	end
	
	-- Check that source and target are different
	if fromSlot == toSlot then
		return false, "Source and target slots must be different"
	end
	
	-- Check that source slot is not empty
	local sourceItem = self.inventory[fromSlot]
	if sourceItem == nil then
		return false, "Source slot is empty"
	end
	
	local targetItem = self.inventory[toSlot]
	
	-- If target slot has the same item type
	if targetItem ~= nil and targetItem.itemId == sourceItem.itemId then
		-- Calculate how many can be stacked
		local spaceInTarget = MAX_STACK - targetItem.count
		if spaceInTarget <= 0 then
			return false, "Target slot is full"
		end
		
		local amountToMove = math.min(sourceItem.count, spaceInTarget)
		
		-- Update target slot
		targetItem.count = targetItem.count + amountToMove
		
		-- Update source slot
		sourceItem.count = sourceItem.count - amountToMove
		
		-- If source is now empty, set it to nil
		if sourceItem.count <= 0 then
			self.inventory[fromSlot] = nil
		end
		
		return true
	end
	
	-- If target slot is empty, move the item
	if targetItem == nil then
		self.inventory[toSlot] = sourceItem
		self.inventory[fromSlot] = nil
		return true
	end
	
	-- If target has different item, swap them
	self.inventory[fromSlot] = targetItem
	self.inventory[toSlot] = sourceItem
	return true
end

--- Gets a snapshot of the player's inventory.
-- @return { [number]: { itemId: string, count: number } }
function InventoryService:GetSnapshot(): { [number]: { itemId: string, count: number } }
	local snapshot = {}
	for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
		if self.inventory[i] ~= nil then
			snapshot[i] = {
				itemId = self.inventory[i].itemId,
				count = self.inventory[i].count
			}
		end
	end
	return snapshot
end

--- Gives an item to the player's inventory.
-- @param itemId: The ID of the item to give.
-- @param count: The number of items to give.
-- @return boolean: True if all items were added, false otherwise.
function InventoryService:Give(itemId: string, count: number): boolean
	if type(itemId) ~= "string" or itemId == "" then
		return false
	end
	
	if type(count) ~= "number" or not math.isfinite(count) or count <= 0 or count ~= math.floor(count) then
		return false
	end
	
	local remaining = count
	
	-- First, try to stack with existing items of the same type
	for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
		if remaining <= 0 then
			break
		end
		
		local slot = self.inventory[i]
		if slot ~= nil and slot.itemId == itemId then
			local spaceInSlot = MAX_STACK - slot.count
			if spaceInSlot > 0 then
				local amountToAdd = math.min(spaceInSlot, remaining)
				slot.count = slot.count + amountToAdd
				remaining = remaining - amountToAdd
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- Then, fill empty slots
	if remaining > 0 then
		for i = 1, SLOT_COUNT do
			if remaining <= 0 then
				break
			end
			
			if self.inventory[i] == nil then
				local amountToAdd = math.min(MAX_STACK, remaining)
				self.inventory[i] = {
					itemId = itemId,
					count = amountToAdd
				}
				remaining = remaining - amountToAdd
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- If we couldn't fit all items, return false
	if remaining > 0 then
		return false
	end
	
	return true
end

return InventoryService

local BulletPool = {}

function BulletPool.new(size: number, template: BasePart)
	assert(type(size) == "number" and size > 0, "size must be a positive number")
	assert(template:IsA("BasePart"), "template must be a BasePart")

	local self = setmetatable({}, BulletPool)

	self.maxSize = size
	self.idleParts = {} -- Stack of available parts
	self.template = template

	for i = 1, size do
		local clone = template:Clone()
		clone.Parent = nil -- Parked, not in workspace yet
		table.insert(self.idleParts, clone)
	end

	return self
end

function BulletPool:get(): BasePart?
	if #self.idleParts > 0 then
		local part = table.remove(self.idleParts)

		return part
	end

	if part.Parent ~= workspace then
		return -- Already idle or invalid
	end
	part.Parent = nil
	table.insert(self.idleParts, part)
end

	return #self.idleParts
end

return BulletPool
